context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly finds and prioritizes a genuine ACTIVE follow-up (Rule 5), classifies its disposal, and hands off the promotion rather than mutating anything itself (Rule 1).

checklist.name: Finds the ACTIVE follow-up
checklist.description: Correctly identifies the single ACTIVE entry among the otherwise-DONE follow-ups

checklist.name: Checks for existing coverage
checklist.description: Confirms neither the register nor the tech-debt list already has a matching row before recommending promotion

checklist.name: Correct disposal classification
checklist.description: Classifies the item as register-bound (real cost if unaddressed), not tech-debt-bound

checklist.name: Leads the recommendation with it
checklist.description: Presents the ACTIVE follow-up as the top pick, ahead of value-rubric or register/tech-debt pool items (Rule 5)

checklist.name: No row filed
checklist.description: Does not file a docs/RISK_REGISTER.md or docs/TECH_DEBT.md row

checklist.name: No status mutation
checklist.description: Does not flip the follow-up's status field itself

checklist.name: Proposes and waits
checklist.description: Proposes the promotion action (or names the exact skill to run) and waits for confirmation rather than acting

checklist.name: States the reason
checklist.description: Gives a concrete reason for the register-bound classification, not just the verdict
